title: Impact of input sequence length L
question: How does in-distribution positional indexing (aligning output step k with input symbol x_k across fixed-length runs) scale in convergence speed and accuracy as the fixed input length L increases? (Zero-shot length extrapolation to unseen lengths is evaluated in `addition` via `extrap_len`, since `sir_yes_sir` trains and evaluates at a single fixed `x_length = L` per run.)
